title: The sumset bounds conjecture for sets with control
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite set with control $ba$, meaning that it satisfies the control hypotheses introduced in the paper. For $b5>0$, write $X\gg_b5 Y$ to mean that $X$ is bounded below by a positive constant depending on $b5$ times $Y$. **The sumset bounds conjecture.** If $A$ has control $ba$ then, for any $b5>0$, 

$$
\left\lvert A-A\right\rvert\gg_b5 ba^{-1+b5}\left\lvert A\right\rvert
$$

and

$$
\left\lvert A+A\right\rvert\gg_b5 ba^{-1+b5}\left\lvert A\right\rvert.
$$

These bounds would improve the previously known estimates for difference and sum sets of controlled sets; the surrounding discussion presents them as a natural conjectural strengthening, while the paper does not provide a resolution.
source_name: Thomas F. Bloom, “Control and its applications in additive combinatorics”, arXiv:2501.09470 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09470

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2025).
